headline: Weathered Expanse Tilts to Wardens; Kuura Strand Goes Colonial
war_summary: Since our last edition the seesaw at Weathered Expanse has tilted Warden-ward: the line there now reads four posts to three in the Wardens' favor, with two more in ruin, after fifty-five flag actions in the past day, the heaviest traffic at Frostmarch and Spirit Watch, the latest logged near the eight o'clock hour. Harder news comes from Kuura Strand, where the Colonials have swept the shore — five of six posts now fly their colors after thirty-one exchanges, though the butchery has eased from its peak. Nevish Line has erupted: better than a thousand casualties a side in two hours, Tomb Father the busiest ground, Wardens still holding six of eight posts. Marban Hollow grinds on about Checkpoint Bua, and Stonecradle shows fresh life at The Reach. The surge at Stlican Shelf has spent itself, Olavis Wake and Pari Peak have gone still, and Farranac Coast and the Dead Lands cool. This is the war's 676th day, with thirty-four victory towns still required and no victor declared.
